title: When configuration
description: Canonical schema for the When self-hosted scheduling app's when.yaml.

Appearance.title: Appearance
Appearance.description: Appearance and theme options for the booking page and emails. Place custom assets in ./public/ to serve them at /public/.

description.default: find some time and we can meet
description.description: Subtext or introduction shown on the booking page.

app_icon_url.description: Path to the app icon (default: the bundled /assets/images/app-icon.svg, a calendar).

avatar_url.description: Path to the avatar image (default: /assets/images/avatar.svg, generated from the owner's name).

favicon_url.description: Path to the favicon image (default: the bundled /assets/images/favicon.svg).

opengraph_url.description: Path to the share (opengraph) image (default: /assets/images/opengraph.png, generated from the appearance).

font_name.description: Font family for the booking page and share card: one of the bundled families (Noto Sans, Lato, Outfit, Inter) or the family name of a custom `font_url` font.

font_url.description: Path to the custom font file (woff2), registered as `font_name`.

primary_light_color.description: Primary brand color for light mode.

primary_dark_color.description: Primary brand color for dark mode.

Auth.title: Auth
Auth.description: Admin authentication strategy. Exactly one of `oidc` or `credentials` must be declared.

oidc.description: Disabled when Credentials auth is active.

AvailabilityRule.title: AvailabilityRule
AvailabilityRule.description: An available time window applied to one or more weekdays. Repeat with the same days for multiple windows.

name.description: Unique name for this calendar, referenced by meetings.

service.description: Name of the caldav or nextcloud service to connect with.

path.description: Relative path joined to the service base URL.

name.description: Unique name for this calendar, referenced by meetings.

service.description: Name of the caldav or nextcloud service to connect with.

url.description: Full calendar URL endpoint overriding the service base URL.

CalDavService.title: CalDavService
CalDavService.description: CalDAV service credentials for generic calendar sync.

name.description: Unique name for the service, referenced by calendars.

url.description: Base URL of your CalDAV endpoint (e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/).

refresh_every_minutes.description: Minutes between the worker's busy-time refreshes for this calendar.

password.description: Admin password. Defaults to the WHEN_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable.

DatabaseConfig.title: DatabaseConfig
DatabaseConfig.description: On-disk SQLite paths. Relative paths resolve against the config directory's parent (the deployment root that holds config/ and data/ as siblings), so web and worker (which load the same when.yaml) open the same files.

FieldCondition.title: FieldCondition
FieldCondition.description: A visibility condition referencing another field.

field.description: Name of an earlier field whose value this condition tests.

equals.description: Value, or list of accepted values, the referenced field must match. Omit to require only that the field has a non-empty value.

FormField.title: FormField
FormField.description: Custom question form fields for bookings.

name.description: Unique name for the form field.

type.description: Type of form field (e.g. guest_name, guest_email, event_location, text, number, phone, paragraph, choice).

label.description: The question prompt or label shown to the user.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled in (default: false).

choices.description: List of options for the choice field type.

show_when.description: Show this field only when every listed condition holds (logical AND). Each condition references an earlier field.

name.description: Unique name for this calendar, referenced by meetings.

service.description: Name of the google service to connect with.

google_calendar_id.description: The specific Google calendar ID (e.g. primary or an email address).

GoogleService.title: GoogleService
GoogleService.description: Google API service credentials. The refresh token is not configured here — connect the service from the admin and it is stored in the database.

name.description: Unique name for the service, referenced by calendars.

LocalPath.description: Root-relative path to an asset this app serves (e.g. /public/icon.png). Remote URLs are not accepted — put the file in ./public/ and reference it at /public/.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: A static location description for a meeting (e.g. an address, a phone number, or a static meeting link).

name.description: Unique name of the meeting (e.g. 30-minute chat).

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the meeting in minutes: a single value, or a list of offered lengths the guest chooses from (default: 30). The first listed length is the default selection.

slug.description: URL slug for the booking page (e.g. "chat" for /schedule/chat). Defaults to a slug derived from the meeting name.

visibility.description: Whether this meeting is listed on the homepage. "unlisted" only hides it from that list — anyone with the /schedule/<slug> link can still book it.

booking_approval.description: The approval flow (default: "request"). "instant" confirms instantly; "request" requires host approval.

busy_calendars.description: Calendar names to check for conflicts (busy times) to block slots.

booking_calendar.description: Calendar name where confirmed bookings will be written. Defaults to the first calendar.

schedule.description: Name of the schedule to use for availability. Defaults to the first schedule.

note.description: A note shown to guests after booking.

video_chat_service.description: Name of the service to generate dynamic links.

start_times_every_minutes.description: Time step in minutes; booking slots will snap to this boundary. Defaults to the meeting's duration_minutes.

notice_minutes.description: Minimum lead time required for bookings in minutes (default: 120).

booking_window_days.description: Maximum number of days in the future that are open for booking (default: 60).

padding_before_minutes.description: Minutes of padding time required before each appointment (default: 0).

padding_after_minutes.description: Minutes of padding time required after each appointment (default: 0).

daily_booking_limit.description: Maximum number of appointments allowed in a single day. null means unlimited (default: null).

form_fields.description: Custom form fields for the booking process.

NextcloudService.title: NextcloudService
NextcloudService.description: Nextcloud service credentials for CalDAV calendar and Talk video chat integrations.

name.description: Unique name for the service, referenced by calendars.

url.description: Base URL of your Nextcloud instance (e.g. https://nextcloud.example.com/).

enabled.description: Whether metrics collection and endpoint are active.

secret.description: Bearer token for scraping metrics. Defaults to METRICS_TOKEN env var.

name.description: Unique name for the schedule, referenced by meetings.

weekly.description: Weekly working hours as availability rules. Defaults to Monday-Friday 09:00-17:00 when omitted.

Smtp.title: Smtp
Smtp.description: SMTP server used to send appointment emails. Required — the appointment system relies on it.

port.description: SMTP server port number (default: 587; e.g. 587 or 465).

from.description: Email address used as the From on all emails and as the organizer on guest-facing calendar invites, so the host's own address is never exposed. Must be an address your SMTP server is allowed to send from. Defaults to noreply@<your url.app domain>. The display name always comes from user.name.

Time.title: Time
Time.description: A wall-clock time as HH:MM (24-hour) in the user's timezone.

app.description: Public base URL of the app (include the scheme), used to build links in emails and calendar events. Defaults to the ORIGIN env var, which adapter-node needs anyway to sit behind a reverse proxy — set ORIGIN alone and both agree.

internal.description: Base URL the worker uses to reach the app over the internal network (e.g. http://when-app:3000), used to fetch relative branding images for embedding in emails. Defaults to the WHEN_URL_INTERNAL env var (baked into the Docker images per target); empty falls back to `app`.

worker.description: Base URL the web app uses to reach the worker over the internal network (e.g. http://when-worker:9000), used to query private worker telemetry and metrics.

name.description: The display name of the schedule owner.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to the TZ environment variable, or UTC when unset.

email.description: Email address of the schedule owner.

appearance.description: Appearance overrides for the schedule owner.

Weekday.title: Weekday
Weekday.description: A day of the week (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun).

WeeklyAvailability.title: WeeklyAvailability
WeeklyAvailability.description: Weekly availability as a list of rules. Availability is the union of all rules; a weekday named by no rule is unavailable.
